答案: D
先把第二式除以 \(2\)，得 \(2x-y-\frac92=0\)。兩直線平行，等距軌跡是中間的平行線，其常數項為 \(\frac{7-\frac92}{2}=\frac54\)。故 \(2x-y+\frac54=0\)，即 \(8x-4y+5=0\)。不能直接平均未正規化的兩個常數項。

questions.stem:
26. A straight line \(L_{1}\) is parallel to the \(x\)-axis and intersects the \(y\)-axis at \((0,-1)\). Straight line \(L_{2}\) is parallel to the \(y\)-axis and intersects the \(x\)-axis at \((1,0)\). A moving point \(P\) is equidistant from \(L_{1}\) and \(L_{2}\). Denote the locus of P by \(\Gamma\). Which of the following are true?
I. \(\quad \Gamma\) pass through \((1,-1)\)
II. \(\quad \Gamma\) is a straight line with slope 1.
III. \(\Gamma\) is a circle with centre \((1,-1)\).
questions.stemZh:
26. \(L_1\) 平行於 \(x\) 軸，經過 \((0,-1)\)；\(L_2\) 平行於 \(y\) 軸，經過 \((1,0)\)。動點 \(P\) 到兩直線的距離相等，其軌跡記為 \(\Gamma\)。下列哪些正確？
I. \(\Gamma\) 通過 \((1,-1)\)。
II. \(\Gamma\) 是一條斜率為 \(1\) 的直線。
III. \(\Gamma\) 是以 \((1,-1)\) 為圓心的圓。
questions.solution: The locus is y=x-2 or y=-x. Both pass through (1,-1); it is neither one line nor a circle. Only I is true; the source key B is wrong.
questions.solutionZh:
Q33. mock-hys-2324-p2-final-q26
答案: A
\(|y+1|=|x-1|\)，所以 \(y=x-2\) 或 \(y=-x\)。兩直線均經過 \((1,-1)\)，只有 I 正確。原答案 B 錯誤。
